title: Apple's New Siri AI on Mac: Features, the Siri App, and How to Use It in 2026
summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple introduced Siri AI, a completely rebuilt assistant powered by Apple Intelligence. On the Mac it lives in Spotlight, in right-click context menus, and in a dedicated Siri app, with Visual Intelligence and onscreen awareness. This is a clear breakdown of what the new Siri AI does on Mac, how to use it, the design choices behind it, what is coming to iPhone, iPad, Vision Pro, and Apple Watch, and how it compares to voice assistants you can already use on Mac and Windows today.
